summary.text: Heather Hadwick is originally from Modoc County and was first elected to the California State Assembly in 2024, representing District 1, according to The Mountain Messenger.

paragraphs.text: The newspaper reports that she is vice chair of the Assembly's Agriculture and Emergency Management Committee, sits on the Budget, Business and Professions, and Insurance Committees, and has been appointed Deputy Leader of the Republican Caucus in the Assembly.

sources.title: District 1 Assemblywoman Hadwick Gets High Marks for Bipartisanship
